Connections are bounded <=5cm plan-gap proposals from fixed-height sections, not measured wall junctions. Full wall-extents geometry remains provisional.
IfcSpace elements are connected floor regions with virtual candidate-door boundaries; not confirmed individual rooms. Attic spaces are not guessed.
Unscanned walls, foundations, stairs, window/door fills and fittings are not invented.
Detected holes at all levels are provisional voids, not verified architectural openings.
No map CRS inferred; public IFC uses the shared relative building coordinates.
